title: Upper and lower support rollers in a saw-blade mesh-belt furnace: which surface carries the parts?
summary: In Suneng's 2018 mesh-belt atmosphere heat-treatment line proposal, the upper row of support rolls carries the forward belt run and the lower row carries its return. They are not two workpiece-loading levels. For preliminary saw-blade assessment, trace the actual loading surface and discharge position first, then compare representative sizes, loading pattern and heating time.
